geometryEvidence.notes: Manufacturer lists 40.7 × 19.7 × 42.9 mm nominal dimensions, while its configure table lists 40.9 × 20 mm, 37 mm case, 42.7 mm overall and 54 mm ear span. The fixed installation reference retains the Rocket Release nominal 40.7 × 19.7 × 37 mm body with 5.9 mm output projection. Shaft axis, Ø6 smooth output, Ø3.4 bores on 48 × 10 mm pitch, ear elevation/thickness and optional horn are unverified fit references. No mounting pitch or spline tooth count is published as a verified catalog attribute. Source travel is 0–159°; geometric pose is centered ±79.5°. Internal gears, motor, supplied arms, screws and 320 mm wire are excluded. Measure the actual servo and resolve the conflicting source dimensions before machining.
